instruction: Minimalist studio portrait photography, close-up shot. In a clean indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the East Asian woman in the beige sleeveless top (R2) and the blonde woman in the white sleeveless top (R1) stand close together shoulder-to-shoulder. The East Asian woman (R2) is on the left, looking forward with a calm expression, cradling her own cheek with her right hand while her left hand gently cups the cheek of the blonde woman (R1). The blonde woman (R1) stands on the right, her head tilted slightly toward her partner, looking directly at the camera with a serene gaze. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates them evenly, highlighting the neutral tones of their clothing and the bright, minimalist setting.
